verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own background automation. Ongoing monitoring can be switched on per customer via the monitoring-configuration API. Its marketed 'agentic workflows' (Customer Screening/Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring agents) auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks and async/batch screening support unattended pipelines. However, the agent capabilities appear only as one-line marketing claims, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized, so the user's ability to set up their own automations is limited. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules/triggers or scheduling, detailed docs on configuring the autonomous agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
